prompt: 生成一段高质量的动画视频，节奏紧凑，高帧率，60帧/秒，镜头与动作编排：0-2s：水墨风格大远景平视，宣纸般的留白画面上，淡墨晕开层层远山，山间云雾以飞白笔触缓缓流动，一叶孤舟浮在淡青色的江面上，镜头缓慢横移，笔墨在画面中一点点生长，仿佛有一支无形的毛笔正在作画。远山之间的飞白里藏着几行淡淡的题诗，墨色尚未干透的笔画在纸上泛着湿润的光泽，江面的波纹由一道道细长的淡墨线条勾勒而成，岸边的芦苇随着笔锋轻轻摇晃，连空气都带着松烟墨特有的清冽气息。2-4s：中景仰拍，一滴浓墨从天而降落在纸上，缓缓晕开成形，@图1（水墨风格的白鹤，长颈修喙，羽尖带墨色，头顶一点朱红）从墨迹中舒展双翅浮现，羽毛由浓转淡，墨点沿着翅尖飘散成雾，镜头缓慢上摇，白鹤昂首一声清唳，震得山间云气荡开涟漪。墨痕所过之处，纸面的纤维清晰可见，飞溅的墨滴在空中悬停一瞬，又被无形的笔触牵引着汇成鹤的轮廓，鹤眼是留白的一点，透着灵动的神采，几片细小的羽毛从翼下脱落，在风里化作淡灰的烟云。4-6s：近景侧拍，@图1（水墨风格的白鹤，长颈修喙，羽尖带墨色，头顶一点朱红）振翅腾空，每一次扇动都在空中留下一道淡墨的轨迹，翅膀掠过水面，倒影在宣纸般的江面上拉出细长的墨线，镜头快速横移追随它的飞行，飞溅的墨点化作飞白的水花。墨点沿着飞行的轨迹在纸上留下一串由浓到淡的印记，江面的小舟里，一位披蓑戴笠的渔翁抬头望天，轻轻举起了酒壶。每一次振翅，纸面都发出轻微的沙沙声，如同蚕食桑叶，淡墨的羽影在空中叠成一层又一层，仿佛时间在画里被无限拉长。6-8s：全景俯拍，白鹤盘旋着穿过两座山峰之间的狭缝，山体的水墨轮廓随它的飞行不断重新晕染，松树从墨点里一棵棵长出，镜头环绕上升，云海在脚下翻涌如泼墨。远处山脊上的亭子随着它飞过的轨迹一座座被点亮，仿佛整幅画卷都在随着这只鹤苏醒，题诗的墨字一个接一个浮现在云间。飞白的笔触在山腰勾出一串串瀑布，白鹤掠过的地方，留白处依次绽开几朵淡红的桃花，花瓣被气流卷起，化作点点朱砂悬在半空。8-10s：特写，@图1（水墨风格的白鹤，长颈修喙，羽尖带墨色，头顶一点朱红）头顶的朱红一点在黑白之间格外鲜亮，镜头快速拉远成大远景，白鹤化作远天里一个小小的墨点，宣纸上最后落下一枚朱红的印章，上面刻着“鹤归”二字。最后一笔收锋时，整幅长卷的墨色同时呼吸般一收一放，远山的轮廓、江上的孤舟、天边的飞鹤彼此呼应，留白处的云气久久不散，仿佛画中的世界仍在继续生长。

Shot and action choreography: 0-2s: Ink-wash style extreme wide eye-level shot: on a rice-paper expanse of empty white, pale ink blooms into layers of distant mountains, clouds drifting between them in dry-brush strokes, a lone boat floating on a light-green river. The camera tracks slowly sideways as ink and brush lines grow bit by bit across the frame as if an invisible brush were painting. Faint lines of inscribed poetry hide in the dry-brush gaps among the far mountains, strokes whose ink has not yet dried gleaming damply on the paper, ripples on the river outlined by slender pale ink lines, reeds on the bank swaying gently with the brush tip, and even the air carries the crisp scent of pine-soot ink. 2-4s: Low-angle medium shot: a drop of dense ink falls from the sky onto the paper, slowly blooming into form, and @图1 (an ink-wash style white crane with a long neck and slender beak, ink-black feather tips, a dot of vermilion on its crown) emerges from the ink stain spreading its wings, feathers fading from dark to pale, ink dots drifting off the wingtips like mist. The camera tilts up slowly as the crane lifts its head and lets out a clear cry, rippling the clouds between the mountains. Wherever the ink passes, the fibers of the paper are clearly visible; flying drops of ink hover for an instant and are drawn by the invisible brush into the outline of the crane, its eye a single spot of blank paper full of lively spirit, a few small feathers falling from under its wings and turning into pale gray smoke in the wind. 4-6s: Close side shot: @图1 (an ink-wash style white crane with a long neck and slender beak, ink-black feather tips, a dot of vermilion on its crown) beats its wings and rises, each flap leaving a trail of pale ink in the air; its wings skim the water, the reflection drawing long ink lines across the paper-like river. The camera tracks sideways fast after its flight, splashed ink dots turning into dry-brush spray. Ink dots leave a trail on the paper from dark to pale along its flight path, and in the little boat on the river a fisherman in straw cloak and hat looks up at the sky and gently lifts his wine gourd. With each wingbeat the paper rustles faintly like silkworms eating mulberry leaves, pale ink feather-shadows stacking layer upon layer in the air as if time were stretched endlessly inside the painting. 6-8s: High-angle wide shot: the crane circles through the narrow gap between two peaks, the ink outlines of the mountains re-blooming as it flies, pine trees growing one by one from ink dots. The camera orbits upward as the sea of clouds below heaves like splashed ink. Pavilions on the distant ridges light up one by one along its flight path as though the whole scroll awakens with this crane, and the inked characters of the poem surface one after another among the clouds. Dry-brush strokes sketch strings of waterfalls along the mountainsides, and where the crane passes, patches of blank paper bloom one after another with pale pink peach blossoms whose petals, lifted by the airflow, become flecks of cinnabar hanging in midair. 8-10s: Close-up: the vermilion dot on @图1 (an ink-wash style white crane with a long neck and slender beak, ink-black feather tips, a dot of vermilion on its crown)'s crown glows vividly against the black and white. The camera pulls back fast into an extreme wide view, the crane shrinking to a tiny ink dot in the distant sky, and a vermilion seal finally lands on the paper, carved with the characters "Crane Returns". As the final stroke lifts, the ink of the whole long scroll contracts and expands as if breathing together, the outlines of far mountains, the lone boat on the river and the crane in the sky answering one another, clouds in the blank spaces lingering as though the world in the painting kept on growing.
